tasks.label: graphify: install CLI
tasks.command: if command -v uv >/dev/null; then uv tool install --upgrade 'graphifyy[mcp,watch,anthropic,openai,gemini]'; elif command -v pipx >/dev/null; then pipx install --force 'graphifyy[mcp,watch,anthropic,openai,gemini]'; else python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade 'graphifyy[mcp,watch,anthropic,openai,gemini]'; fi

tasks.label: graphify: update targets changed vs origin/main
tasks.command: git fetch --quiet origin main && bash .github/graphify/update.sh --changed origin/main

tasks.label: graphify: serve MCP over HTTP (localhost:8099)
tasks.detail: Streamable HTTP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:8099/mcp; set GRAPHIFY_API_KEY to require a key

inputs.description: Target directory to rebuild (must be listed in .github/graphify/targets.txt)
Symbol, file or concept names to look up (labels match better than full sentences)
